description: A package that writes the global as it loads (load-flag): it adds `globalThis.__loadedFlag`, counting its evaluations, and replaces `globalThis.atob` with a wrapper named patchedAtob. Two files on one worker in the node environment each import it and assert both. Jest evaluates the package in every file's registry against a fresh global, so each file sees the flag at 1 and the wrapper; a runner that loads it once per worker and restores the global after each file leaves the second file with neither. No network. Read by `provino`'s `ecosystem-per-file.test.ts`.
